findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.useronda.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile, show_project_settings, list_env_vars, create_env_setup_link, open_session, get_diff, open_pr, get_pr_status, show_variants, show_session_panel, show_projects, show_choices · Private data: create_project, show_project_settings, list_env_vars, create_env_setup_link, classify_env_vars, save_project_profile, save_project_rule, list_files, read_file, search_code, get_diff, apply_patch, create_file, write_file, run_script, install_package, restart_dev_server, get_edit, undo_changes, keep_variant, send_feedback, submit_feedback, report_onboarding_event · Public sink: get_profile, create_setup_link, show_project_settings, create_env_setup_link, send_feedback, submit_feedback · Destructive: create_project, start_sample_project, update_project_settings, apply_patch, write_file, run_script, install_package, show_projects, keep_variant.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile, show_project_settings, list_env_vars, create_env_setup_link, open_session, get_diff, open_pr, get_pr_status, show_variants, show_session_panel, show_projects, show_choices · Private data: create_project, show_project_settings, list_env_vars, create_env_setup_link, classify_env_vars, save_project_profile, save_project_rule, list_files, read_file, search_code, get_diff, apply_patch, create_file, write_file, run_script, install_package, restart_dev_server, get_edit, undo_changes, keep_variant, send_feedback, submit_feedback, report_onboarding_event · Public sink: get_profile, create_setup_link, show_project_settings, create_env_setup_link, send_feedback, submit_feedback · Destructive: create_project, start_sample_project, update_project_settings, apply_patch, write_file, run_script, install_package, show_projects, keep_variant

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
